summary.tldr: Sets out a federal vision for a Canada-wide early learning and child care system, commits to long-term funding, and creates an advisory council.
what_it_does: Sets out the Government of Canada’s vision for a Canada-wide early learning and child care system.
Commits to maintaining long-term federal funding for early learning and child care for provinces and Indigenous peoples.
Creates the National Advisory Council on Early Learning and Child Care.
who_it_affects: Early learning and child care providers
summary.background: The bill was introduced in the House of Commons on 8 December 2022 and given first reading.
